notes: This file is the ONLY place a state-action-to-FEMA-declaration link becomes
publishable. build_state_evidence.py reads this file but never writes it.
A link candidate generated automatically (same state, compatible hazard,
date window, similar storm name) stays unpublished until a human adds it
here with status 'accepted'. 'rejected' entries are kept, not deleted, so
the builder does not re-propose the same wrong candidate on the next run.
